rules: No parser text or model output used to assign source truth.
All retained pages inspected; boundaries and continuations explicitly verified.
Repeated identical values grouped; multiple distinct valid destinations retained.
DATE: explicit year/month/day; scope excludes conditional/relative unsupported or ambiguous forms.
EMAIL: distinguish direct submission role from incidental contacts.
Absence scoped to complete notice, not broader proceeding; no absent-field inference from missing candidates.
Source conflicts remain conflicts; no legal precedence or date arithmetic.
Labels READY before runtime outputs; all amendments versioned.
